title: Brought into the King's Chamber by Timothy Hogan

tellings.quote:
I went I was I was brought into the
King's Chamber by him personally.

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on the show, says he was personally taken into the King's Chamber, the main granite room deep inside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt, by a man named Timothy Hogan. He tells this as something he did himself, sometime in the 2020s, to show he has had close access to Hogan and to the pyramid.
